title: Checkout Canary Regression
content: If checkout-api 5xx increases after canary traffic shift, inspect Istio VirtualService, Argo Rollouts, p95 latency and deployment revision. Safe action is pause rollout or rollback after approval.

title: Fraud Kafka Lag
content: For fraud-detection-engine consumer lag, check consumer group lag, rebalance events, consumer pod restarts, downstream DB latency and recent deployment. Safe action is scale consumers or rollback after approval.

title: Trade Rebalance RCA
content: Deployment caused consumer restarts and Kafka rebalance, increasing order latency during market open. Recovery was pausing rollout and restoring stable replicas.

title: Payment DB Timeout
content: For payment database timeouts, inspect DB pool saturation, slow SQL, dependency errors and SLO burn. Production changes require payment owner approval.

title: Kubernetes OOMKilled
content: For OOMKilled pods, check memory limits, node pressure, previous logs, VPA recommendations and image changes. Avoid blind limit increases without validation.
